title.value: Compositional Attention: Disentangling Search and Retrieval
title.justification: The title reflects the main topic of the paper, which aims to introduce a novel attention mechanism called Compositional Attention that disentangles the search and retrieval process in neural networks.
title.quote: C OMPOSITIONAL A TTENTION : D ISENTANGLING S EARCH AND R ETRIEVAL

extractions.description: This paper introduces Compositional Attention, a novel attention mechanism that separates the processes of search and retrieval, aiming to improve learning efficiency and generalization in neural networks, particularly transformers. The mechanism allows for flexible and dynamic pairing of search and retrieval operations, potentially reducing parameter redundancies and enhancing task performance across various domains such as natural language processing, computer vision, and logical reasoning. The approach is tested against standard multi-head attention in transformer models, showing improved performance in various tasks, including image classification and logical reasoning challenges.
